nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=30 beats='First snow on Bramble Hill; the last sled run is done; little Ari has lost one blue boot with a silver lightning bolt, and the sun is sinking fast'>>

choices.label: Zip up and face the hill

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=36 beats='From the bottom Priya scans the hill: sled grooves climbing to the orange flags and the big pine, and below, the snow fort and creek bridge where Mia plays; Ari hugs his bare foot'>>

choices.label: Ask Mia by the snow fort

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=15 beats='Priya flips the red sled; no boot beneath it; blue yarn curls on the tow rope'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=15 beats='The rope dragged over the bumpy middle; a grass tuft flutters blue threads; a tall pink drift glows below'>>

choices.label: Stand mid-run and look both ways

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=15 beats='Mia waves from her crooked snow fort; the tunnel glows cold and blue; the creek shines below'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=15 beats='Popping out of the tunnel: the ice hums softly; a long fallen branch leans against the snowy bank'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=36 beats='Mid-run Priya weighs two scuffed trails: upward toward the sagging flag line and the arguing crow, or downward to the kicked-flat bumps and the tall drift'>>

choices.label: Hike up toward flags and pine

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=38 beats='At the hilltop the orange flag line sags where a blue thread hangs; a drag mark ends at the pine where the crow tugs a blue bootlace; the squirrel scolds from a leaf-stuffed hollow'>>

choices.label: Walk the drag mark to the pine

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=16 beats='Priya tugs the rope; the flags rattle overhead; something small and dark swings right above her nose'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=40 beats='The crow pile winks with caps, one spoon, a marble, and a snug blue wedge; the hollow behind rustles with acorns; the shiny red button on the coat of Priya glints in the low sun'>>

choices.label: Offer the crow your shiny button

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=38 beats='Lower down, kicked-flat crust hugs the tuft with its matching blue threads; the tall drift holds one frosted blue boot-toe; the first path lamp buzzes awake'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=16 beats='Mittened hands scoop through the crust; something hard wiggles under the snow, cold as a popsicle'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=40 beats='Priya climbs on knees and elbows while snow slides under her; the toe is nearly in reach; behind her the lamps flicker on and the sky turns the deep color of grape juice'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=34 beats='By the bridge the ice shelf gleams below; the shed of Mr. Diaz holds the lost and found; Mia swings her sled bag and waits'>>

choices.label: Try the shed lost and found

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=38 beats='Under the bridge the boot sits on the ice shelf just past mittened reach; the long branch waits on the bank; past the bend the melt patch bubbles gray around a hard hump'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=16 beats='Belly-down at the safe edge of the bank, Priya stretches the branch; the hooked tip taps the blue heel once, twice'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=16 beats='Two careful steps into the slush; the cold bites through her boots; both hands close around the muddy hump'>>

choices.label: Heave it out of the mud

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=34 beats='The box holds three mittens, a plastic dinosaur, one huge green boot; Mia offers a fuzzy spare from her bag; the lamps along the path say home right now'>>

choices.label: Leave a note in the box

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=50 beats='Priya scoops the crust away and pulls, and out pops the blue lightning-bolt boot, dry inside; they tug it onto the foot of Ari, and the walk home is stomp-stomp-giggle all the way'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Priya grabs the blue toe and pulls; the boot slides out with a quiet pouf of snow where the last bump flung it; the trip home is Ari riding the sled with both boots on, Priya pulling, stars coming out over Bramble Hill'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The plum-dark swallows the hill, and blue on black snow is invisible; the lamp path pulls them home with one foot of Ari in a doubled sock under a plastic bag; Mom promises flashlights at dawn, and Priya already knows where to look'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=50 beats='The small dark thing drops into her mittens: the boot, flung onto the flag line by the first whooshing run of the day; Ari cheers so loudly the flags rattle again, and two warm feet stomp home'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Priya sets the shiny red button on the snow and steps back; the crow snatches it, satisfied, and lets the blue wedge pull free: the boot at last; all winter the button may shine from a nest while Ari stomps home in two warm boots'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Fingers close on cold rubber at the very back of the hollow; out comes the boot plus a rain of surprised acorns; Priya leaves the spoon and the marble for the squirrel, who stops scolding mid-chatter, and the walk home is loud and happy'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=50 beats='Hook the lace loop, breathe out slow, lift steady; the boot swings over the bank and lands in the snow with a soft whump; Ari hugs it like a puppy, and two boots stomp home under brand-new stars'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=50 beats='The hump pops free with a shlurp: the boot, muddy outside and dry inside where it counts; Ari laughs at his mud-spattered boot the whole way home, and tonight there will be a bath for boots'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Priya pins a note to the box: lost, one blue boot, silver lightning bolt, size small, loved very much; Mr. Diaz adds his flashlight to tomorrow and promises to watch the run; home is cocoa and a plan, which is not nothing at all'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Mia digs a fuzzy spare boot from her sled bag, nearly the right size; Ari walks home lopsided and proud between the two bigger kids; tomorrow the whole fort crew will search again, sleds loaded with flashlights and string cheese'>>
